messages:
sam_support: Heads-up — acme reported repeat 502s + spikes in p95 at ~2026-03-17T14:02Z. They didn’t include any request ids. What’s the shortest, customer-friendly checklist I can send to get a repro bundle?
jen: Minimal things I ask for (one-liner): exact UTC time window, the Redwood request id or debug token, a HAR or curl repro, SDK debug logs, and the endpoint/model they called.
arc: Can you paste the little template I can drop into the chat with the customer?
maria_repro: Here — short + copyable. Use this and ask them to redact secrets: 

```
Hi — thanks for reporting. To help us reproduce and escalate please send: 
1) The exact UTC time range when the error happened (e.g. 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z to 2026-03-17T14:05:00Z)
2) Any request id / trace id you can find (look for header `x-request-id` or a "requestId" token in SDK logs)
3) A HAR file from the browser OR a curl command that reproduces the call (see example below)
4) SDK debug logs (enable the SDK debug flag or attach application logs around the time window)
5) Model/route name, and approximate tokens sent/received
6) Your account/org id (if different from the account email)

Example curl (no real keys):
```
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# In verbose output look for a response header like: x-request-id: abcd-1234
```

Browser HAR tip:
- Chrome/Edge: DevTools -> Network -> reproduce -> Right-click -> Save all as HAR with content. Attach the .har. We can search the HAR for the request/response that has the error and pull headers/body.

SDK log tip:
- Ask them to enable debug logging in their SDK (or attach app logs). Search logs for strings: `requestId=`, `req_id:`, or `x-request-id`. Example log line we look for:
```
INFO  api_client - request completed status=502 requestId=abcd-1234 latency_ms=512
```

Console/Redwood UI tip:
- If they can access the Console: Console -> Requests/Recent Requests -> filter by time -> click the row -> click "Copy debug token" (or "Copy request id") and paste it here. The debug token lets us pull full server-side traces.

Privacy note: redact any PII / full API keys before sending files; HARs are okay if keys are removed.

Thanks — once you paste any `x-request-id` or the debug token we can pull the server-side trace and link it to infra logs.
```

arc: Nice. Add the bit about what we need when they send a HAR that has multiple requests (how to point to the failing request).
maria_repro: Add: tell them to include the request timestamp and the request path (e.g. POST /v1/generate). We’ll search the HAR for that exact path and time window.
deploy-bot: incident-alert: no active deploys during 2026-03-17T13:55Z..2026-03-17T14:10Z :white_check_mark:
sam_support: Perfect — I’ll send this to the customer now. If they paste a debug token I’ll drop it here and loop eng-repro. :thumbsup:
